keyPoints.en: Before the World Wars, local people had already begun to oppose colonial rule — first by arms, then through education, writing and associations.
keyPoints.bm: Sebelum Perang Dunia, penduduk tempatan sudah mula menentang penjajahan — mula-mula dengan senjata, kemudian melalui pendidikan, penulisan dan persatuan.

keyPoints.en: This early awareness meant that when war came, many people were ready to question colonial power.
keyPoints.bm: Kesedaran awal ini menyebabkan apabila perang meletus, ramai rakyat sudah bersedia mempersoalkan kuasa penjajah.

meaning.en: The first feelings of wanting to defend the homeland and its people from foreign control.
meaning.bm: Perasaan awal ingin mempertahankan tanah air dan rakyat daripada kawalan asing.

points.en: Local leaders resisted British interference in the 19th and early 20th centuries.
points.bm: Pemimpin tempatan menentang campur tangan British pada abad ke-19 dan awal abad ke-20.

points.en: In the 1920s–1930s, newspapers, SITC and associations such as KMS and KMM spread nationalist ideas.
points.bm: Pada 1920-an hingga 1930-an, akhbar, MPSI dan persatuan seperti KMS dan KMM menyebarkan idea nasionalisme.

question.en: How did nationalism before the war prepare people for the Japanese Occupation?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah nasionalisme sebelum perang menyediakan rakyat menghadapi Pendudukan Jepun?

answer.en: Leaders and associations had already spread awareness of colonial injustice, so groups like the KMM were organised and ready to act when the British were defeated.
answer.bm: Pemimpin dan persatuan sudah menyebarkan kesedaran tentang ketidakadilan penjajah, maka kumpulan seperti KMM sudah tersusun dan bersedia bertindak apabila British dikalahkan.

keyPoints.en: World War I (1914–1918) was caused by rivalry between imperialist powers, military alliances and the Balkan crisis.
keyPoints.bm: Perang Dunia Pertama (1914–1918) berpunca daripada persaingan kuasa imperialis, pakatan tentera dan krisis rantau Balkan.

keyPoints.en: The spark: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary was assassinated in Sarajevo on 28 June 1914.
keyPoints.bm: Pencetusnya: Archduke Franz Ferdinand dari Austria-Hungary dibunuh di Sarajevo pada 28 Jun 1914.

keyPoints.en: The war ended with the Paris Peace Conference and the Treaty of Versailles (1919).
keyPoints.bm: Perang berakhir dengan Persidangan Damai Paris dan Perjanjian Versailles (1919).

keyPoints.en: Effects: the fall of monarchies, the birth of new countries, and effects on our country.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: keruntuhan pemerintahan beraja, kemunculan negara baharu dan kesan terhadap negara kita.

meaning.en: Powers competing to build empires and colonies.
meaning.bm: Persaingan kuasa-kuasa membina empayar dan tanah jajahan.

meaning.en: Britain, France and Russia.
meaning.bm: Britain, Perancis dan Rusia.

meaning.en: Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy (Italy later changed sides).
meaning.bm: Jerman, Austria-Hungary dan Itali (Itali kemudian bertukar pihak).

meaning.en: 1919 treaty that blamed Germany for the war, took its colonies, limited its army and made it pay reparations.
meaning.bm: Perjanjian 1919 yang menyalahkan Jerman, merampas tanah jajahannya, mengehadkan tenteranya dan memaksanya membayar ganti rugi.

meaning.en: International body set up after WWI to keep peace.
meaning.bm: Badan antarabangsa yang ditubuhkan selepas PD1 untuk menjaga keamanan.

heading.en: a. Causes of World War I

points.en: Rivalry of imperialist powers for colonies, markets and raw materials.
points.bm: Persaingan kuasa imperialis untuk tanah jajahan, pasaran dan bahan mentah.

points.en: Military alliances meant a local quarrel quickly dragged in many countries.
points.bm: Pakatan tentera menyebabkan pertelingkahan kecil cepat melibatkan banyak negara.

points.en: Balkan crisis: nationalism among Slav peoples led to the Sarajevo assassination.
points.bm: Krisis Balkan: nasionalisme bangsa Slav membawa kepada pembunuhan di Sarajevo.

heading.en: b. End of World War I

points.en: Germany signed an armistice on 11 November 1918.
points.bm: Jerman menandatangani gencatan senjata pada 11 November 1918.

points.en: Paris Peace Conference (1919) → Treaty of Versailles signed on 28 June 1919.
points.bm: Persidangan Damai Paris (1919) → Perjanjian Versailles ditandatangani pada 28 Jun 1919.

heading.en: c. Effects of World War I

points.en: Fall of monarchies: Russia (1917), Germany, Austria-Hungary and the Ottoman Empire.
points.bm: Keruntuhan pemerintahan beraja: Rusia (1917), Jerman, Austria-Hungary dan Empayar Uthmaniyah.

points.en: New countries: e.g. Poland, Czechoslovakia and Yugoslavia.
points.bm: Negara baharu: cth. Poland, Czechoslovakia dan Yugoslavia.

points.en: Our country: the German cruiser Emden attacked Penang harbour (28 October 1914); the Indian troops' mutiny in Singapore (1915); demand for rubber and tin rose; the Malay rulers of the FMS paid for the battleship HMS Malaya.
points.bm: Negara kita: kapal penjelajah Jerman Emden menyerang pelabuhan Pulau Pinang (28 Oktober 1914); dahagi askar India di Singapura (1915); permintaan getah dan bijih timah meningkat; raja-raja Melayu NNMB membiayai kapal perang HMS Malaya.

event.en: Battle of Penang — the Emden attacks.

alt.en: Delegations sign the Treaty of Versailles in the Hall of Mirrors, 28 June 1919.
alt.bm: Perwakilan menandatangani Perjanjian Versailles di Dewan Cermin, 28 Jun 1919.

caption.en: Delegations sign the Treaty of Versailles in the Hall of Mirrors, 28 June 1919.
caption.bm: Perwakilan menandatangani Perjanjian Versailles di Dewan Cermin, 28 Jun 1919.

images.credit: Helen Johns Kirtland (1890-1979) and Lucian Swift Kirtland (died 1965) · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons

question.en: Explain how military alliances caused World War I to spread.
question.bm: Jelaskan bagaimana pakatan tentera menyebabkan Perang Dunia Pertama merebak.

answer.en: Countries promised to defend their allies. When Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia, Russia backed Serbia, Germany backed Austria-Hungary, and France and Britain joined — a local conflict became a world war.
answer.bm: Negara berjanji mempertahankan sekutu. Apabila Austria-Hungary mengisytiharkan perang ke atas Serbia, Rusia menyokong Serbia, Jerman menyokong Austria-Hungary, lalu Perancis dan Britain turut serta — konflik setempat menjadi perang dunia.

tip.en: Causes of WWI: I-P-B — Imperialisme, Pakatan tentera, Balkan.
tip.bm: Punca PD1: I-P-B — Imperialisme, Pakatan tentera, Balkan.

keyPoints.en: World War II in Europe (1939–1945) began when Germany invaded Poland on 1 September 1939.
keyPoints.bm: Perang Dunia Kedua di Eropah (1939–1945) bermula apabila Jerman menyerang Poland pada 1 September 1939.

keyPoints.en: Causes: new ideologies (fascism, Nazism), anger at the Treaty of Versailles and the failure of the League of Nations.
keyPoints.bm: Punca: kemunculan ideologi baharu (fasisme, Nazisme), ketidakpuasan hati terhadap Perjanjian Versailles dan kegagalan Liga Bangsa.

keyPoints.en: Germany conquered much of Western Europe, bombed Britain and invaded the Soviet Union in 1941.
keyPoints.bm: Jerman menakluki sebahagian besar Eropah Barat, mengebom Britain dan menyerang Kesatuan Soviet pada 1941.

keyPoints.en: The war in Europe ended when Germany surrendered in May 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Perang di Eropah berakhir apabila Jerman menyerah kalah pada Mei 1945.

meaning.en: Extreme nationalist, one-party rule led by a dictator — Mussolini in Italy.
meaning.bm: Pemerintahan satu parti yang nasionalis melampau di bawah diktator — Mussolini di Itali.

meaning.en: Hitler's ideology in Germany: racism, expansion and dictatorship.
meaning.bm: Ideologi Hitler di Jerman: perkauman, peluasan wilayah dan pemerintahan diktator.

meaning.en: "Lightning war" — fast attacks with tanks and aircraft.
meaning.bm: "Perang kilat" — serangan pantas dengan kereta kebal dan pesawat.

meaning.en: Allies: Britain, USA, USSR, France and others. Axis: Germany, Italy, Japan.
meaning.bm: Berikat: Britain, Amerika Syarikat, Kesatuan Soviet, Perancis dan lain-lain. Paksi: Jerman, Itali, Jepun.

meaning.en: 6 June 1944: Allied landing in Normandy, France.
meaning.bm: 6 Jun 1944: pendaratan tentera Berikat di Normandy, Perancis.

heading.bm: a. Faktor tercetusnya perang di Eropah

points.en: New ideologies: Mussolini (Italy) and Hitler (Germany) wanted to expand by force.
points.bm: Ideologi baharu: Mussolini (Itali) dan Hitler (Jerman) mahu meluaskan kuasa secara kekerasan.

points.en: Germany was angry at the harsh Treaty of Versailles.
points.bm: Jerman tidak berpuas hati dengan Perjanjian Versailles yang keras.

points.en: The League of Nations failed to stop aggression (e.g. Italy in Ethiopia, Japan in Manchuria).
points.bm: Liga Bangsa gagal menghalang pencerobohan (cth. Itali di Ethiopia, Jepun di Manchuria).

heading.bm: b. Perang Dunia Kedua di Eropah

points.en: 1940: Germany conquered the Netherlands, Belgium and France.
points.bm: 1940: Jerman menakluki Belanda, Belgium dan Perancis.

points.en: 1940–1941: German bombing of Britain (the Blitz); Italy joined the war in June 1940.
points.bm: 1940–1941: Jerman mengebom Britain (the Blitz); Itali menyertai perang pada Jun 1940.

points.en: 22 June 1941: Germany attacked the Soviet Union (Operation Barbarossa).
points.bm: 22 Jun 1941: Jerman menyerang Kesatuan Soviet (Operasi Barbarossa).

heading.en: c. End of the war in Europe

points.en: Cooperation of the great powers (Britain, USA, USSR) and effective strategy.
points.bm: Kerjasama kuasa besar (Britain, Amerika Syarikat, Kesatuan Soviet) dan strategi yang berkesan.

points.en: Germany failed to capture Russia — defeat at Stalingrad (1943).
points.bm: Jerman gagal menawan Rusia — kekalahan di Stalingrad (1943).

points.en: Allied landings in Normandy (D-Day, 6 June 1944) freed Western Europe; Germany surrendered on 8 May 1945.
points.bm: Pendaratan tentera Berikat di Normandy (D-Day, 6 Jun 1944) membebaskan Eropah Barat; Jerman menyerah kalah pada 8 Mei 1945.

event.en: France falls; Italy enters the war.

alt.en: American troops land on Omaha Beach, Normandy, on D-Day, 6 June 1944.
alt.bm: Tentera Amerika mendarat di Pantai Omaha, Normandy, pada D-Day, 6 Jun 1944.

caption.en: American troops land on Omaha Beach, Normandy, on D-Day, 6 June 1944.
caption.bm: Tentera Amerika mendarat di Pantai Omaha, Normandy, pada D-Day, 6 Jun 1944.

images.credit: Chief Photographer's Mate (CPHoM) Robert F. Sargent · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons

question.en: Why did the League of Nations fail to prevent World War II?
question.bm: Mengapakah Liga Bangsa gagal menghalang Perang Dunia Kedua?

answer.en: It had no army of its own, some great powers (e.g. the USA) were not members, and it could not stop aggression by Italy, Germany and Japan.
answer.bm: Ia tidak mempunyai tentera sendiri, sesetengah kuasa besar (cth. Amerika Syarikat) bukan ahli, dan ia tidak dapat menghalang pencerobohan Itali, Jerman dan Jepun.

keyPoints.en: Japan expanded its empire to get raw materials and markets: Manchuria (1931), then war with China (1937).
keyPoints.bm: Jepun meluaskan empayarnya untuk mendapatkan bahan mentah dan pasaran: Manchuria (1931), kemudian perang dengan China (1937).

keyPoints.en: The USA, Britain and the Netherlands placed economic sanctions on Japan, including oil (1941).
keyPoints.bm: Amerika Syarikat, Britain dan Belanda mengenakan sekatan ekonomi ke atas Jepun, termasuk minyak (1941).

keyPoints.en: Japan planned to conquer Southeast Asia's resources in the south.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun merancang menakluki sumber Asia Tenggara di selatan.

keyPoints.en: War in the Asia Pacific began with attacks on Kota Bharu and Pearl Harbor (7–8 December 1941).
keyPoints.bm: Perang di Asia Pasifik bermula dengan serangan ke atas Kota Bharu dan Pearl Harbor (7–8 Disember 1941).

keyPoints.en: It ended after atomic bombs on Hiroshima (6 Aug) and Nagasaki (9 Aug); Japan surrendered on 15 August 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Ia berakhir selepas bom atom digugurkan di Hiroshima (6 Ogos) dan Nagasaki (9 Ogos); Jepun menyerah kalah pada 15 Ogos 1945.

term.bm: Kawasan Kesemakmuran Bersama Asia Timur Raya

meaning.en: Japan's plan for an Asian bloc led by Japan — really a way to control Asia's resources.
meaning.bm: Rancangan Jepun untuk blok Asia yang dipimpin Jepun — sebenarnya cara menguasai sumber Asia.

meaning.en: Stopping trade with a country to pressure it.
meaning.bm: Menghentikan perdagangan dengan sesebuah negara untuk menekannya.

meaning.en: US naval base in Hawaii attacked by Japan on 7 December 1941 (8 December in Asia).
meaning.bm: Pangkalan tentera laut Amerika di Hawaii yang diserang Jepun pada 7 Disember 1941 (8 Disember di Asia).

points.en: Expansion policy: Japan needed oil, rubber, tin and markets for its industries.
points.bm: Dasar peluasan kuasa: Jepun memerlukan minyak, getah, bijih timah dan pasaran untuk industrinya.

points.en: Sanctions in 1941 cut off most of Japan's oil, pushing it to seize the resources of the south.
points.bm: Sekatan pada 1941 memutuskan sebahagian besar bekalan minyak Jepun, mendorongnya merampas sumber di selatan.

heading.en: b. War begins in the Asia Pacific
heading.bm: b. Bermulanya perang di Asia Pasifik

points.en: Japan landed at Kota Bharu and attacked Pearl Harbor almost at the same time, then moved quickly through Southeast Asia.
points.bm: Jepun mendarat di Kota Bharu dan menyerang Pearl Harbor hampir serentak, kemudian mara pantas ke seluruh Asia Tenggara.

points.en: The USA won back the Pacific island by island; atomic bombs were dropped in August 1945.
points.bm: Amerika Syarikat merampas semula pulau-pulau Pasifik satu demi satu; bom atom digugurkan pada Ogos 1945.

points.en: Emperor Hirohito announced surrender on 15 August 1945; it was signed on 2 September 1945 aboard USS Missouri.
points.bm: Maharaja Hirohito mengumumkan penyerahan pada 15 Ogos 1945; ia ditandatangani pada 2 September 1945 di atas kapal USS Missouri.

event.en: Landing at Kota Bharu; Pearl Harbor attacked.
event.bm: Pendaratan di Kota Bharu; Pearl Harbor diserang.

event.en: Atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
event.bm: Bom atom di Hiroshima dan Nagasaki.

alt.bm: USS Shaw meletup semasa serangan Jepun ke atas Pearl Harbor, 7 Disember 1941.

question.en: Why did economic sanctions push Japan to attack Southeast Asia?
question.bm: Mengapakah sekatan ekonomi mendorong Jepun menyerang Asia Tenggara?

answer.en: Japan depended on imported oil and raw materials. When sanctions cut these off, Japan decided to seize the oil, rubber and tin of Southeast Asia by force.
answer.bm: Jepun bergantung pada minyak dan bahan mentah import. Apabila sekatan memutuskan bekalan ini, Jepun memutuskan untuk merampas minyak, getah dan bijih timah Asia Tenggara secara kekerasan.

keyPoints.en: Japan came to our country to exploit raw materials (tin, rubber, oil, iron ore) and for strategic military reasons.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun datang ke negara kita untuk mengeksploitasi bahan mentah (bijih timah, getah, petroleum, bijih besi) dan atas kepentingan strategik ketenteraan.

keyPoints.en: The Strait of Melaka and Britain's naval base in Singapore were key targets.
keyPoints.bm: Selat Melaka dan pangkalan tentera laut British di Singapura menjadi sasaran utama.

keyPoints.en: Japanese troops landed at Kota Bharu on 8 December 1941 and advanced south quickly, many on bicycles.
keyPoints.bm: Tentera Jepun mendarat di Kota Bharu pada 8 Disember 1941 dan mara ke selatan dengan pantas, ramai menaiki basikal.

keyPoints.en: Singapore surrendered on 15 February 1942; Sarawak and Sabah were also occupied.
keyPoints.bm: Singapura menyerah kalah pada 15 Februari 1942; Sarawak dan Sabah turut diduduki.

meaning.en: Important for war and defence, e.g. controlling a sea route.
meaning.bm: Penting untuk peperangan dan pertahanan, cth. menguasai laluan laut.

meaning.en: British warships sunk by Japanese aircraft off Kuantan on 10 December 1941.
meaning.bm: Kapal perang British yang ditenggelamkan pesawat Jepun di perairan Kuantan pada 10 Disember 1941.

points.en: Exploiting raw materials: our country was rich in tin and rubber; Sarawak (Miri) had oil.
points.bm: Eksploitasi sumber bahan mentah: negara kita kaya dengan bijih timah dan getah; Sarawak (Miri) mempunyai petroleum.

points.en: Military strategy: controlling the Strait of Melaka and Singapore opened the way to the Dutch East Indies.
points.bm: Kepentingan strategik ketenteraan: menguasai Selat Melaka dan Singapura membuka jalan ke Hindia Timur Belanda.

heading.en: a. Japanese attack on our country
heading.bm: a. Serangan Jepun terhadap negara kita

points.en: Landing at Kota Bharu (8 Dec 1941) and in southern Thailand; air attacks on British bases.
points.bm: Pendaratan di Kota Bharu (8 Dis 1941) dan di selatan Thailand; serangan udara ke atas pangkalan British.

points.en: 10 Dec 1941: HMS Prince of Wales and HMS Repulse sunk off Kuantan.
points.bm: 10 Dis 1941: HMS Prince of Wales dan HMS Repulse ditenggelamkan di perairan Kuantan.

points.en: Kuala Lumpur fell on 11 January 1942; Lt-Gen Percival surrendered Singapore to Gen Yamashita on 15 February 1942.
points.bm: Kuala Lumpur jatuh pada 11 Januari 1942; Lt-Jen Percival menyerahkan Singapura kepada Jen Yamashita pada 15 Februari 1942.

points.en: Borneo: Japan landed at Miri (16 Dec 1941), took Kuching (Dec 1941) and Labuan (1 Jan 1942).
points.bm: Borneo: Jepun mendarat di Miri (16 Dis 1941), menawan Kuching (Dis 1941) dan Labuan (1 Jan 1942).

event.en: Prince of Wales and Repulse sunk.
event.bm: Prince of Wales dan Repulse ditenggelamkan.

alt.bm: Tentera Jepun di Kuala Lumpur, 11 Januari 1942.

question.en: Why was Japan able to conquer our country so quickly?
question.bm: Mengapakah Jepun dapat menakluki negara kita dengan begitu cepat?

answer.en: Japanese forces were well prepared and used fast tactics (bicycles, jungle routes), controlled the air and sea after sinking two British warships, while British forces were spread thin and unprepared for an attack from the north.
answer.bm: Tentera Jepun bersiap sedia dan menggunakan taktik pantas (basikal, laluan hutan), menguasai udara dan laut selepas menenggelamkan dua kapal perang British, manakala tentera British berselerak dan tidak bersedia menghadapi serangan dari utara.

keyPoints.en: Japan ruled through a military administration and used different policies for different groups.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun memerintah melalui pentadbiran tentera dan menggunakan dasar berbeza untuk kumpulan berbeza.

keyPoints.en: Administration: Malay rulers kept their posts only as heads of Islam and Malay custom; real power was with the Japanese.
keyPoints.bm: Pentadbiran: raja-raja Melayu kekal hanya sebagai ketua agama Islam dan adat Melayu; kuasa sebenar di tangan Jepun.

keyPoints.en: Economy: resources were exploited, "banana money" caused inflation, food was scarce and rationed.
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi: sumber dieksploitasi, "duit pisang" menyebabkan inflasi, makanan berkurangan dan dicatu.

keyPoints.en: Society: Japanese language and culture were taught; Chinese suffered harshly (Sook Ching); Indians were recruited into the INA.
keyPoints.bm: Sosial: bahasa dan budaya Jepun diajar; orang Cina menderita teruk (Sook Ching); orang India direkrut ke dalam INA.

meaning.en: Government run by the army, with army officers as administrators.
meaning.bm: Pemerintahan oleh tentera, dengan pegawai tentera sebagai pentadbir.

meaning.en: Japanese military police feared for arrests and torture.
meaning.bm: Polis tentera Jepun yang digeruni kerana penangkapan dan penyeksaan.

meaning.en: "Purge through cleansing" — mass screening and killing of Chinese men suspected of being anti-Japanese (1942).
meaning.bm: "Pembersihan" — pemeriksaan dan pembunuhan beramai-ramai lelaki Cina yang disyaki anti-Jepun (1942).

meaning.en: Japanese-issued currency with a banana tree on the $10 note; printed without limit so it lost value.
meaning.bm: Mata wang keluaran Jepun dengan gambar pokok pisang pada wang $10; dicetak tanpa had sehingga hilang nilai.

meaning.en: "Light of the South" — Japan's name for Singapore.
meaning.bm: "Cahaya Selatan" — nama Jepun bagi Singapura.

meaning.en: Siam–Burma railway built by forced labour, including many from Malaya; thousands died.
meaning.bm: Landasan kereta api Siam–Burma yang dibina dengan buruh paksa, termasuk ramai dari Tanah Melayu; ribuan terkorban.

points.en: Japanese military administration, at first with Malaya and Sumatra under one government in Singapore.
points.bm: Pentadbiran Tentera Jepun, pada awalnya Tanah Melayu dan Sumatera di bawah satu pentadbiran berpusat di Singapura.

points.en: Malay rulers: kept as heads of Islam and Malay custom but lost political power.
points.bm: Raja-raja Melayu: dikekalkan sebagai ketua agama Islam dan adat Melayu tetapi hilang kuasa politik.

points.en: In 1943 Japan handed Perlis, Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu to Thailand.
points.bm: Pada 1943 Jepun menyerahkan Perlis, Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu kepada Thailand.

points.en: Local leaders: some Malays were given administrative posts and councils were formed to win support.
points.bm: Kepimpinan tempatan: sesetengah orang Melayu diberi jawatan pentadbiran dan majlis ditubuhkan untuk meraih sokongan.

points.en: Rubber, tin and other resources were taken for Japan's war.
points.bm: Getah, bijih timah dan sumber lain diambil untuk peperangan Jepun.

points.en: Banana money was printed freely → inflation and a black market.
points.bm: Duit pisang dicetak sewenang-wenangnya → inflasi dan pasaran gelap.

points.en: Education: Japanese language (Nippon-go), songs and culture; pupils bowed towards Tokyo every morning.
points.bm: Pendidikan: bahasa (Nippon-go), lagu dan budaya Jepun; murid tunduk ke arah Tokyo setiap pagi.

points.en: Religion: Islam was allowed but controlled; the occupiers tried to use religion for propaganda.
points.bm: Agama: Islam dibenarkan tetapi dikawal; penjajah cuba menggunakan agama untuk propaganda.

points.en: Food: rationing; people were told to grow tapioca, sweet potatoes and vegetables.
points.bm: Makanan: catuan; rakyat disuruh menanam ubi kayu, ubi keledek dan sayur.

points.en: Treatment: Malays treated less harshly; Chinese brutally (China was Japan's enemy); Indians encouraged to join the INA to free India.
points.bm: Layanan: orang Melayu dilayan kurang keras; orang Cina dilayan dengan kejam (China musuh Jepun); orang India digalakkan menyertai INA untuk membebaskan India.

alt.bm: Wang kertas sepuluh dolar keluaran Jepun ("duit pisang") yang digunakan semasa pendudukan.

question.en: Why did the Japanese treat ethnic groups differently, and what was the long-term effect?
question.bm: Mengapakah Jepun melayan kaum secara berbeza, dan apakah kesan jangka panjangnya?

answer.en: To divide the people and win support from some groups (divide and rule). It created suspicion between the races that led to clashes after the war.
answer.bm: Untuk memecahbelahkan rakyat dan meraih sokongan sesetengah kumpulan (pecah dan perintah). Ia menimbulkan syak wasangka antara kaum yang membawa kepada pertelingkahan selepas perang.

tip.en: Three policies: Pentadbiran, Ekonomi, Sosial — give one fact for each.
tip.bm: Tiga dasar: Pentadbiran, Ekonomi, Sosial — beri satu fakta bagi setiap satu.

keyPoints.en: Many groups and individuals fought the Japanese, openly or secretly.
keyPoints.bm: Banyak kumpulan dan individu menentang Jepun, secara terbuka atau rahsia.

keyPoints.en: The Malay Regiment defended Singapore bravely — Lt Adnan Saidi at Bukit Chandu (Pasir Panjang), February 1942.
keyPoints.bm: Rejimen Askar Melayu mempertahankan Singapura dengan berani — Leftenan Adnan Saidi di Bukit Chandu (Pasir Panjang), Februari 1942.

keyPoints.en: The MPAJA fought a guerrilla war, helped by the British Force 136.
keyPoints.bm: MPAJA menjalankan perang gerila, dibantu oleh Force 136 British.

keyPoints.en: Individuals such as Sybil Kathigasu and Gurchan Singh resisted secretly; in Borneo, Operation Semut and the Jesselton Revolt (1943).
keyPoints.bm: Individu seperti Sybil Kathigasu dan Gurchan Singh menentang secara rahsia; di Borneo, Operasi Semut dan Pemberontakan Jesselton (1943).

meaning.en: Malayan Peoples' Anti-Japanese Army — guerrillas led by the Communist Party of Malaya, mostly Chinese.
meaning.bm: Tentera Anti-Jepun Penduduk Tanah Melayu — gerila dipimpin Parti Komunis Malaya, kebanyakannya orang Cina.

meaning.en: British special unit that trained, armed and supplied local resistance fighters.
meaning.bm: Pasukan khas British yang melatih, mempersenjatai dan membekalkan pejuang tempatan.

meaning.en: Small-group surprise attacks from hiding places, e.g. the jungle.
meaning.bm: Serangan hendap oleh kumpulan kecil dari tempat persembunyian, cth. hutan.

meaning.en: Allied operation in Sarawak (1945) supported by local Dayak communities.
meaning.bm: Operasi Berikat di Sarawak (1945) yang disokong masyarakat Dayak tempatan.

meaning.en: Jesselton Revolt on 10 October 1943, led by Albert Kwok with the Kinabalu Guerrillas.
meaning.bm: Pemberontakan Jesselton pada 10 Oktober 1943, dipimpin Albert Kwok bersama Gerila Kinabalu.

heading.en: a. Malay Regiment — defenders of the homeland
heading.bm: a. Rejimen Askar Melayu — benteng pertahanan tanah air

points.en: The Malay Regiment fought to the end at Pasir Panjang and Bukit Chandu (13–14 Feb 1942); Lt Adnan Saidi refused to surrender and was killed.
points.bm: Askar Melayu bertempur hingga ke akhir di Pasir Panjang dan Bukit Chandu (13–14 Feb 1942); Leftenan Adnan Saidi enggan menyerah dan terkorban.

points.en: MPAJA attacked Japanese posts and supply lines from jungle bases.
points.bm: MPAJA menyerang pos dan laluan bekalan Jepun dari pangkalan di hutan.

points.en: Force 136 parachuted officers, weapons and radios to the guerrillas; Malay fighters also joined Force 136 (e.g. the Askar Melayu Setia).
points.bm: Force 136 menerjunkan pegawai, senjata dan radio kepada gerila; pejuang Melayu juga menyertai Force 136 (cth. Askar Melayu Setia).

points.en: Kuomintang (Chinese Nationalist) guerrillas also fought the Japanese and at times cooperated with the MPAJA.
points.bm: Gerila Kuomintang (Nasionalis Cina) turut menentang Jepun dan ada kalanya bekerjasama dengan MPAJA.

points.en: Sybil Kathigasu, a nurse in Papan, Perak, secretly treated guerrillas and listened to banned radio; she was tortured by the Kempeitai but never betrayed them.
points.bm: Sybil Kathigasu, jururawat di Papan, Perak, merawat gerila secara rahsia dan mendengar radio terlarang; beliau diseksa Kempeitai tetapi tidak pernah membocorkan rahsia.

points.en: Gurchan Singh ("Singa") ran an underground anti-Japanese campaign and spread leaflets.
points.bm: Gurchan Singh ("Singa") menjalankan kempen anti-Jepun secara rahsia dan menyebarkan risalah.

heading.en: g. Anti-Japanese movements in Sarawak and Sabah
heading.bm: g. Gerakan anti-Jepun di Sarawak dan Sabah

points.en: Operation Semut: Allied soldiers parachuted into Sarawak and worked with Dayak communities.
points.bm: Operasi Semut: tentera Berikat diterjunkan ke Sarawak dan bekerjasama dengan masyarakat Dayak.

points.en: Jesselton Revolt (10 Oct 1943): Albert Kwok's Kinabalu Guerrillas, with local fighters, attacked the Japanese; the revolt was crushed and the leaders executed.
points.bm: Pemberontakan Jesselton (10 Okt 1943): Gerila Kinabalu pimpinan Albert Kwok, bersama pejuang tempatan, menyerang Jepun; pemberontakan dipatahkan dan pemimpinnya dihukum bunuh.

question.en: Explain the role of Force 136 during the Japanese Occupation.
question.bm: Jelaskan peranan Force 136 semasa Pendudukan Jepun.

answer.en: It sent trained officers into Malaya, supplied the guerrillas with weapons, radios and money, gathered intelligence and prepared for the Allies' return.
answer.bm: Ia menghantar pegawai terlatih ke Tanah Melayu, membekalkan senjata, radio dan wang kepada gerila, mengumpul maklumat risikan dan membuat persediaan untuk kepulangan tentera Berikat.

keyPoints.en: The Japanese Occupation strengthened anti-colonial feelings.
keyPoints.bm: Pendudukan Jepun menguatkan semangat anti-penjajah.

keyPoints.en: Britain's quick defeat ended the belief that Western powers could not be beaten.
keyPoints.bm: Kekalahan pantas British menghapuskan kepercayaan bahawa kuasa Barat tidak boleh dikalahkan.

keyPoints.en: Malay radicals worked towards independence: KMM, then PETA (1943) and KRIS (1945).
keyPoints.bm: Golongan radikal Melayu berusaha ke arah kemerdekaan: KMM, kemudian PETA (1943) dan KRIS (1945).

keyPoints.en: Political awareness also grew in Sarawak and Sabah.
keyPoints.bm: Kesedaran politik turut berkembang di Sarawak dan Sabah.

meaning.en: Pembela Tanah Air (1943) — Malay volunteer army set up under the Japanese, led by Ibrahim Yaacob.
meaning.bm: Pembela Tanah Air (1943) — pasukan sukarela Melayu di bawah Jepun, dipimpin Ibrahim Yaacob.

meaning.en: Kesatuan Rakyat Indonesia Semenanjung (1945) — planned independence together with Indonesia.
meaning.bm: Kesatuan Rakyat Indonesia Semenanjung (1945) — merancang kemerdekaan bersama Indonesia.

meaning.en: Idea of uniting the Malay Peninsula with Indonesia as one nation.
meaning.bm: Gagasan menyatukan Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dengan Indonesia sebagai satu negara.

heading.en: a. Growth of the anti-colonial spirit

points.en: People saw that Asians could defeat Western powers; they wanted to rule themselves.
points.bm: Rakyat melihat bangsa Asia boleh mengalahkan kuasa Barat; mereka mahu memerintah sendiri.

heading.bm: b. Perjuangan menuntut kemerdekaan dalam kalangan orang Melayu

points.en: Japan banned the KMM in 1942 but later set up PETA (1943) under Ibrahim Yaacob.
points.bm: Jepun mengharamkan KMM pada 1942 tetapi kemudian menubuhkan PETA (1943) di bawah Ibrahim Yaacob.

points.en: KRIS (July 1945) planned to declare independence with Indonesia, but Japan surrendered first.
points.bm: KRIS (Julai 1945) merancang mengisytiharkan kemerdekaan bersama Indonesia, tetapi Jepun menyerah kalah terlebih dahulu.

heading.en: c. Political awareness in Sarawak and Sabah
heading.bm: c. Kesedaran politik di Sarawak dan Sabah

points.en: Hardship under Japan made local people more aware of their rights and future.
points.bm: Kesengsaraan di bawah Jepun menjadikan penduduk tempatan lebih sedar akan hak dan masa depan mereka.

question.en: How did the Japanese Occupation strengthen nationalism?

answer.en: It broke the myth of Western superiority, gave some locals training and posts, and showed the need to defend the homeland themselves — so demands for independence grew after the war.
answer.bm: Ia menghapuskan mitos keunggulan Barat, memberi sesetengah penduduk tempatan latihan dan jawatan, serta menunjukkan perlunya mempertahankan tanah air sendiri — maka tuntutan kemerdekaan meningkat selepas perang.

keyPoints.en: Japan surrendered on 15 August 1945; British forces only returned in September 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun menyerah kalah pada 15 Ogos 1945; tentera British hanya kembali pada September 1945.

keyPoints.en: In this short gap, the MPAJA (known as Bintang Tiga) took control of many areas.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam tempoh singkat ini, MPAJA (dikenali sebagai Bintang Tiga) menguasai banyak kawasan.

keyPoints.en: Bintang Tiga punished people it called collaborators, which led to racial clashes.
keyPoints.bm: Bintang Tiga menghukum mereka yang dianggap tali barut Jepun, lalu mencetuskan pertelingkahan kaum.

keyPoints.en: Leaders worked to calm the situation; the British set up the BMA. In Sarawak, Australian forces took over first.
keyPoints.bm: Para pemimpin berusaha meredakan keadaan; British menubuhkan BMA. Di Sarawak, tentera Australia mengambil alih terlebih dahulu.

meaning.en: "Three Stars" — name for the MPAJA after its three-star cap badge.
meaning.bm: "Tiga Bintang" — nama MPAJA sempena lencana tiga bintang pada topinya.

meaning.en: Someone who helped the enemy (the Japanese).
meaning.bm: Orang yang membantu musuh (Jepun).

meaning.en: A time when no government is in control.
meaning.bm: Tempoh tiada kerajaan yang berkuasa.

heading.en: a. Japan's defeat and the end of the war
heading.bm: a. Kekalahan Jepun dan berakhirnya Perang Dunia Kedua

points.en: After the atomic bombs Japan surrendered (15 Aug 1945); the formal surrender in Singapore was signed before Lord Mountbatten on 12 September 1945.
points.bm: Selepas bom atom Jepun menyerah kalah (15 Ogos 1945); penyerahan rasmi di Singapura ditandatangani di hadapan Lord Mountbatten pada 12 September 1945.

heading.bm: b. Penguasaan Bintang Tiga di Tanah Melayu

points.en: For about two weeks Bintang Tiga ruled many towns, held "people's courts" and took revenge.
points.bm: Selama kira-kira dua minggu Bintang Tiga menguasai banyak pekan, mengadakan "mahkamah rakyat" dan membalas dendam.

points.en: Malay response: clashes broke out in places such as Batu Pahat (Johor) and Sungai Manik (Perak).
points.bm: Tindak balas orang Melayu: pertempuran meletus di tempat seperti Batu Pahat (Johor) dan Sungai Manik (Perak).

points.en: Compromise: community leaders, including Dato' Onn Jaafar in Johor, worked to stop the fighting.
points.bm: Kompromi: pemimpin masyarakat, termasuk Dato' Onn Jaafar di Johor, berusaha menghentikan pertempuran.

points.en: Sarawak: Australian forces accepted the Japanese surrender and ran a military administration.
points.bm: Sarawak: tentera Australia menerima penyerahan Jepun dan menjalankan pentadbiran tentera.

event.en: British forces return; BMA set up.

question.en: Why did racial clashes break out after Japan surrendered?
question.bm: Mengapakah pertelingkahan kaum berlaku selepas Jepun menyerah kalah?

answer.en: There was no government in control; Bintang Tiga took revenge on people it accused of helping the Japanese, many of them Malays, and the different treatment of races under Japan had already created suspicion.
answer.bm: Tiada kerajaan yang berkuasa; Bintang Tiga membalas dendam terhadap mereka yang dituduh membantu Jepun, ramai daripadanya orang Melayu, dan layanan berbeza terhadap kaum semasa Jepun telah menimbulkan syak wasangka.

tip.en: Remember the "14 days" between Japan's surrender and the British return — a favourite question.
tip.bm: Ingat tempoh "14 hari" antara penyerahan Jepun dan kepulangan British — soalan kegemaran.
